 Automated Sample Changer XRDynamic Autosampler 
 Automated Sample Changer XY Stage 
Key features 
Documents 
Compatible instruments 
Similar products 
The XRDynamic Autosampler and sample changer options for the XY Stage enhance Anton Paar’s XRD solutions with high sample capacity, seamless integration, and flexible performance. Combined with XRDynamic 500, they enable efficient, automated measurements for all sample types, with consistently reliable results.
Key features
Highest sample capacity
The XRDynamic Autosampler sets the benchmark with the ability to handle up to 105 samples using industry-standard sample holders. This unmatched capacity enables longer walkaway times, and significantly boosts lab throughput and efficiency: 
Supports 105 standard sample holders for transmission and/or reflection measurements
Designed for all sample types (powders, solids, fibers, foils, thin films, air-sensitive samples)
Enables extended, unattended operation
Outstanding performance and flexibility
The XRDynamic Autosampler as well as the sample changer option for the XY Stage facilitate operation and ensure precise results across various sample types and applications, thanks to automatic geometry switching and height alignment – saving hours of manual instrument adaptations
Supports domed holders for air-sensitive samples
Delivers consistent, high-quality data
Seamless integration
Customers benefit from error minimization and efficiency maximization. Fully integrated with XRDdrive software, the sample changer option for the XY Stage as well as the XRDynamic Autosampler and its magazines are instantly recognized upon connection. Combined with the automation level of XRDynamic 500, it ensures:
Plug-and-play setup
Reduced user intervention
High throughput with reduced manual handling errors
Scalable and non-intrusive
Easily mounted on any XRDynamic 500 instrument, the XRDynamic Autosampler never interferes with other measurements when it is not in use, and it is both removable and expandable: 
No interference with other measurements
Scales from one to seven magazines
Fast and precise installation
A portfolio covering every need
The XRDynamic Autosampler perfectly complements the existing portfolio of the XRDynamic 500 sample changer option for the XY Stage, with three, six, 12, or 48 sample positions. 
This gives users even greater flexibility when it comes to choosing the perfect solution for their applications and challenges.
